Grande Portage Resources Ltd.: Advancing Its High-Grade New Amalga Gold Project in Alaska

(OTCQX: GPTRF) (FSE: GPB) (the "Company" or "Grande Portage") reviewed its direct-ship ore plan for the New Amalga Gold Project near Juneau, Alaska. The review covered the results of its April 2026 Preliminary Economic Assessment, a definitive gold purchase agreement with Ocean Partners UK Limited, and the project's acceptance onto the federal permitting dashboard under Title 41 of the Fixing America's Surface Transportation Act (FAST-41).

The article examines how eliminating onsite processing and tailings storage simplifies the project's path through federal environmental review, against the backdrop of permitting timelines becoming a primary constraint on new mine development in North America.

Grande Portage Resources Ltd. is a mineral exploration and development company advancing the New Amalga Gold Project, the outgrowth of the Herbert Gold discovery, located approximately 25 kilometres north of Juneau, Alaska. The company holds a 100% interest in the property, which lies within the 160-kilometre Juneau Gold Belt. The New Amalga gold system is open along strike and at depth and hosts at least six main composite vein-fault structures. Grande Portage is headquartered in Vancouver, British Columbia.

Market One is a Canadian marketing agency for public companies, delivering best-in-class content creation and distribution. The firm helps position companies for meaningful engagement through a suite of products across video, editorial, and social media. Clients benefit from increased visibility and strengthened awareness through Market One's content and relationships with industry-leading media outlets.
